title: Sequences, series and limits in ℝ
description: ε–N arguments, convergence, Cauchy sequences, completeness of ℝ, uniform versus pointwise convergence.

title: Metric spaces
description: Metrics, open and closed sets, convergence, continuity, compactness and completeness in metric spaces.

title: Vector spaces and linear maps
description: Abstract vector spaces over ℝ or ℂ, bases, dimension, linear maps, matrices, inner products in finite dimensions.

title: Mathematical proof and quantifiers
description: Reading and writing proofs; quantifier order; counterexamples; proof by contradiction and induction.

title: Normed vector space
description: A vector space with a norm; the induced metric; examples ℓ^p, C(K), L^p and non-examples.

title: Equivalence of norms
description: Two norms are equivalent when each bounds the other up to a constant; all norms on a finite-dimensional space are equivalent, and this fails in infinite dimensions.

title: Banach space
description: A complete normed space; completeness of ℓ^p, C(K) and L^p; the role of absolutely convergent series.

title: Bounded linear operator and operator norm
description: Boundedness equals continuity for linear maps; the operator norm; B(X,Y) is Banach when Y is.

title: Quotient of a normed space by a closed subspace
description: The quotient norm, completeness of the quotient of a Banach space by a closed subspace.

title: Baire category theorem
description: A complete metric space is not a countable union of nowhere dense sets; consequences for Banach spaces.

title: Uniform boundedness principle
description: Pointwise boundedness of a family of bounded operators on a Banach space implies uniform boundedness.

title: Open mapping and closed graph theorems
description: A surjective bounded operator between Banach spaces is open; bounded inverse; closed graph theorem.

title: Hahn–Banach theorem
description: Extension of bounded functionals; Zorn's lemma; separation and the richness of the dual.

title: Dual space and double dual
description: Bounded linear functionals, the dual norm, the canonical embedding into the double dual, reflexivity.

title: Lebesgue outer measure
description: Outer measure on subsets of ℝ via countable interval covers; monotonicity and countable subadditivity.

title: σ-algebras and measurable sets
description: σ-algebras, Borel sets, Carathéodory measurability, Lebesgue measurable sets.

title: Lebesgue measure
description: Countable additivity on measurable sets, regularity, translation invariance, null sets.

title: Measurable functions
description: Measurability via preimages, closure under limits, simple functions and approximation.

title: Lebesgue integral
description: Integral of simple, nonnegative and integrable functions; monotone and dominated convergence; Fatou.

title: L^p spaces
description: Hölder and Minkowski inequalities, completeness (Riesz–Fischer), density of simple and continuous functions.

title: Hilbert space
description: Inner products, Cauchy–Schwarz, parallelogram law, completeness, orthogonality and projections.

title: Orthonormal bases and Fourier series
description: Bessel's inequality, Parseval, completeness of orthonormal systems, Fourier series in L^2.

title: Riesz representation theorem
description: Every bounded functional on a Hilbert space is an inner product with a unique vector; orthogonal complements and minimisers.

title: Adjoint of a bounded operator
description: Existence and properties of the adjoint on a Hilbert space; self-adjoint, unitary and normal operators.

title: Compact operators
description: Compact subsets of a Hilbert space, finite-rank operators, norm limits, the ideal of compact operators.

title: Spectrum of a bounded operator
description: Spectrum and resolvent, spectral radius, spectrum of self-adjoint operators is real.

title: Spectral theorem for compact self-adjoint operators
description: Eigenvalue decomposition of compact self-adjoint operators; application to the Dirichlet problem on an interval.

title: Measure and integration (course-level)
description: Working knowledge of σ-algebras, measures, measurable functions and the Lebesgue integral with its convergence theorems.

title: Measure-theoretic probability
description: Probability spaces, random variables as measurable functions, expectation as integral, independence.

title: Martingales
description: Conditional expectation, filtrations, martingale convergence and optional stopping.

title: General topology
description: Topological spaces, bases, continuity, compactness, connectedness, Hausdorff spaces, quotient and product topologies.

title: Smooth manifolds and charts
description: Topological manifolds, smooth atlases, smooth maps, tangent spaces, the coordinate singularity of a chart.

title: Tangent bundle, vector fields and differentials
description: Tangent vectors as derivations, pushforwards, vector fields, flows, differential forms.

title: Riemannian metrics
description: Positive-definite inner products on tangent spaces varying smoothly; induced metrics; metric coefficients in coordinates.

title: Connections and geodesics
description: Levi-Civita connection, Christoffel symbols, geodesics and the exponential map.

title: Curvature
description: Riemann curvature tensor, sectional, Ricci and scalar curvature; model spaces.

title: Lorentzian metrics
description: Non-degenerate indefinite metrics of signature (−,+,+,+); causal structure; distinction from Riemannian metrics.

title: Multivariable calculus
description: Partial derivatives, chain rule, inverse and implicit function theorems, multiple integrals.

title: Groups, subgroups and homomorphisms
description: Group axioms, examples (symmetric, cyclic, dihedral, matrix groups), subgroups, cosets, Lagrange's theorem, homomorphisms and isomorphisms.

title: Normal subgroups and quotient groups
description: Normal subgroups, quotient groups, the isomorphism theorems, correspondence theorem.

title: Group actions
description: Orbits, stabilisers, the orbit–stabiliser theorem, Burnside counting, class equation.

title: Sylow theorems and finite group structure
description: p-groups, Sylow theorems, classification of small groups, simple groups.

title: Rings, ideals and fields
description: Rings, ideals, quotient rings, integral domains, fields, polynomial rings.

title: Complex analysis
description: Holomorphic functions, Cauchy's theorem and integral formula, power series, residues.

title: Fourier analysis
description: Fourier series and transforms, convergence, convolution, Plancherel.

title: Ordinary differential equations
description: Existence and uniqueness, linear systems, stability, phase portraits.

title: Partial differential equations
description: Classical equations (Laplace, heat, wave), separation of variables, weak formulations.

title: Convex analysis and optimisation
description: Convex sets and functions, duality, subgradients, optimality conditions.

title: Numerical methods
description: Floating point, conditioning, linear solvers, interpolation, quadrature, ODE integration and stability.
